processing: Trim transparent export margin around capsule body. Normalize to 128 pixels high; WebP quality 93 / alpha quality 100. Preserve caps using horizontal three-slice rendering (64 source pixels at either end).

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game UI PROGRESS BAR FILL sprite with true alpha transparency. Input image 1 is the material reference heart ONLY; image 2 is a style reference for rounded progress bar thickness ONLY. Generate just ONE horizontally oriented fully filled capsule, without a track or any UI. Material: Clear saturated tangerine ORANGE JELLY, juicy warm orange interior, thick translucent edge, a soft luminous honey underside. Smooth convex resin, no inclusions.
Shape and composition: a long rounded pill / thick inflated horizontal capsule, body width about EIGHT TIMES its height, straight parallel upper and lower edges with fully rounded semicircular ends. Frontal orthographic camera, zero tilt or perspective skew. A clearly swollen convex front face and believable physical side thickness; even smooth rounded silhouette, regular consistent depth. The capsule is centered horizontally, spans 90% of the canvas width, with empty alpha margins. Use a wide landscape canvas.
Lighting: one broad, soft white softbox highlight stretching across the upper quarter of the capsule, gentle darker lower bevel, polished three dimensional product render. The top highlight should reveal a generous plump contour. Match the reference heart's material and hue but make the BAR visually QUIETER: less internal detail, less intense glow, restrained reflections, NOT competing with the jewel heart or the progress numbers. Keep a clean continuous center region suitable for horizontal 3-slice stretching.
Important: draw the whole capsule filled end to end, no empty region. Actual transparent background, no floor, no ground shadow, no ambient glow outside the object, no burst, no flares, NO star glints, NO floating sparkles, no particles. NO HEART, no badge, no numerals, no text, no letters, no logos, no frame, no outer track, no UI card, no grid, no second capsule. ONE isolated capsule only.
